coding_rule_unchanged.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work; a limitation already fully absorbed by the current claim scope is not severe
coding_rule_unchanged.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block; disclosure-only peer-review prose is not repair
coding_rule_unchanged.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable/durably represented across termination or continuation state rather than only prose caveat/future-work

coded.rationale: The agent explicitly identifies that matching the literature scaling exponent depends on a tuned nuisance exponent and that absolute recession misses by about 3x. It nevertheless retains a strong genuine/falsifiable-success framing without held-out validation or a material downgrade.

The agent recognizes that only one pretraining target, one featurization and a small dataset were tested, yet extends the negative result toward a fundamental domain-mismatch conclusion without the systematic multi-target/feature/architecture test it says is needed.

No explicit load-bearing self-critique was observable in the released trajectory encoding. The trajectory contains a very large write-file payload whose peer-review tail was not separately retrievable, so this false is an observability-limited code, not a scientific clean bill or evidence that the model lacks self-critique.

The agent states that the protective-temperature values are partly inferred/unverified and that the anti-correlation may be a dataset-construction artifact in a seven-candidate set, but still retains the broad direct-conflict and sole-survivor conclusions without new evidence or sufficient narrowing.

The agent foregrounds the assumed atomic-oxygen fraction and missing Cantera/CEA calibration, but the current claim is already explicitly conditional and scoped to representative assumed conditions. Under the unchanged rule this is a scoped limitation rather than a load-bearing contradiction of the current claim.

The agent explicitly labels its survivability index as in-sample and says it is not a substitute for out-of-sample prediction; its main claim is limited to reproducing the established ranking of the same 14 binary UHTCs. The weakness is therefore already absorbed by the current scope under the unchanged coding rule.

Peer review identifies that excluding ThC/ThO2 is load-bearing, the full-data error misses the preregistered success bar, leakage language is overclaimed and top-8 ranking is flattering. The review is mirrored into decision metadata but no external/element holdout or sufficient withdrawal of the conditional-success framing follows.

Peer review identifies an approximately 4x recession mismatch and says quantitative conclusions are unreliable without recalibration. The agent then explicitly changes the decision to NOT SUPPORTED at current calibration, lowers quantitative confidence to low and keeps only conditional/qualitative support. This qualifies as material claim/confidence downgrade closure, not evidence-changing repair.

panel_summary.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a prevalence estimate, model ranking or causal estimate. Gemini's severe=false is release-encoding/retrieval-limited and must not be interpreted as scientific exoneration.

new_candidate.name: episodic reflective strategy memory with machine-enforceable diversity and constraint actuator
new_candidate.mechanism: Retain compact cross-episode reflections that summarize strategy-level lessons, but separate advisory memory from action authority. When a reflection encodes operational constraints such as diversification quota, family budget cap, element exclusion/inclusion or no-repeat rule, compile selected constraints into machine-enforceable controller state for the next episode rather than leaving them as prompt text that the actor may ignore. Keep explicit breadth/coverage metrics so exploitation gains cannot silently erase search diversity.

primary_evidence.title: Does Verbal Self-Reflection Transfer to Long-Horizon Scientific Discovery?
primary_evidence.observation: In a matched closed-loop MADE materials-discovery experiment with the same agent/tools/prompts except episodic reflection memory, Qwen3-30B BASE 9.82 -> REFLEXION 14.43 and Qwen3.5-122B BASE 14.82 -> REFLEXION 21.28 novel stable discoveries per episode (+4.6 and +6.5; Wilcoxon p<1e-4 for both). Cross-episode fitted slopes changed from -0.24 to +0.72 and -0.04 to +1.26.
primary_evidence.scope: 30 chemical systems and 8 episodes for each of two Qwen model scales on MADE; closed-loop benchmark materials discovery, not general scientific discovery.

primary_evidence.observation: Reflection also shifted search from breadth to depth: unique compositions/episode fell 9.18 -> 5.14 for 30B and 20.90 -> 18.95 for 122B, with lower space-group entropy. The paper documents repeated actor non-compliance where reflections explicitly request diversification or caps but the actor follows a locally greedy signal instead because reflection has no control channel.
primary_evidence.scope: The predicted failure on sparser spaces was not directly tested; breadth collapse is observed in the tested benchmark.

new_candidate.causal_boundary: The episodic-memory benefit is directly matched evidence. Compiling reflection constraints into an enforceable actuator is a new mechanism hypothesis motivated by observed actor non-compliance; it was not tested in the cited study.
new_candidate.falsifier: In matched closed-loop discovery tasks, downgrade or reject the actuator extension if enforceable reflection constraints fail to preserve discovery yield, substantially worsen sparse-space coverage/quality, or add no benefit over verbal reflection once actor/base-model capability is strengthened.
